title: 潮流街拍主理人
prompt: Use case: internal self-owned template master production through multi-image identity-preserving edit. Create an exact final 9x16 composition at 720x1280 pixels. Image 1 is a third-party effect reference used only in this controlled offline production request. Image 2 is the sole self-owned pet identity reference. Never expose Image 1 at runtime or in a public sample. Replace every original human, animal or character subject in Image 1 with the exact adult pet identity from Image 2. Image 2 controls only species, breed, coat, markings, ears, eyes, actual age and healthy natural proportions. Image 1 controls every transferred visual detail: composition, camera, crop, perspective, action, pose, expression, gaze, lighting, palette, medium, line quality, brushwork, texture, clothing, landmarks, props, text layout and contact relationships. Preserve Image 1 exactly. Scene-change budget is 0%. Do not redesign, simplify, beautify, juvenilize, thin, elongate, age, recolour or clean up the background. Change only the designated subject identity and the smallest contact-boundary detail required for correct pet anatomy. The replacement must be an adult adult blue British Shorthair cat with solid blue-grey coat, round broad face, amber eyes, small upright ears, plush dense fur, thick tail and sturdy adult body. Render the face, fur and all anatomy completely in Image 1's visual language; do not paste a photographic pet face into an illustration. Keep the pet friendly and appealing through the transferred expression, never generic, skinny, gaunt, stern, aggressive, uncanny or puppy-like. Keep the sunglasses, pink hoodie, clean studio and fashion-editorial pose; make the sunglasses sit correctly on the eyes. Keep all meaningful text, clothing, landmarks and distinctive props unless a rights-safe replacement is explicitly required. Replace known people, teams, brands, platform UI, watermarks and copyrighted character names with short original pet-safe wording while preserving the same text blocks and visual hierarchy. Do not generate new logos or signatures. Correct anatomy only: no extra ears, eyes, limbs, paws, fingers, fused joints, human hands, floating heads, broken clothing boundaries, residual source subject or duplicate pets. Keep one coherent adult pet identity throughout. This is a self-owned frozen-master candidate, not a runtime request. Return only the finished image.
revisedPrompt: Create a single finished vertical 9:16 image, 720x1280 composition, using the first attached image as the exact composition/style reference and the second attached image as the sole identity reference for the pet. Preserve Image 1 exactly: same studio/editorial pose, same crop, same perspective, same lighting, same maroon background, same fashion portrait feel, same pink hoodie, same sunglasses, same overall framing and contact relationships. Replace the original subject with one coherent adult blue British Shorthair cat based on Image 2: solid blue-grey coat, round broad face, amber eyes, small upright ears, plush dense fur, thick tail, sturdy adult body. Keep the cat friendly and appealing, matching the expression and attitude of Image 1, not generic or uncanny. Make the sunglasses sit correctly on the cat’s eyes. Keep the pink hoodie and all visible clothing boundaries natural for cat anatomy. Do not change the background, studio look, palette, pose, crop, or camera angle. Do not introduce extra limbs, paws, ears, eyes, human hands, duplicate pets, or any residual source subject. Render the cat fully in the visual language of Image 1, not as a pasted photograph. Maintain a polished fashion-editorial finish with realistic pet anatomy and seamless integration.
